title: A Statistical Case Against Empirical Human–AI Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing empirical alignment metrics (like MAUVE) against prescriptive metrics (like QText) and human evaluations for LLM decoding strategies, specifically demonstrating how sequence length truncation in empirical metrics introduces selective inference and post-selection bias.

Theoretical and philosophical analysis demonstrating how exclusively aligning AI with observed human behavior restricts AI to human-centric perspectives and phenomena, conceptualized as an observation selection effect.
